$comment: Closing brand statement (the giant outlined wordmark above the footer). Editable content — safe for a CMS. `words` renders one per line, so ['Young','Architects'] is a two-line lockup; each line is styled as a single unwrapped row, so keep lines short. `tagline.lead` is muted and `tagline.accent` receives the brand gradient. Rendered on every route via the app shell.
